policy.core: Verified VN100 financial-report universe; membership is retained independently of liquidity.
policy.liquid: Non-core HOSE symbols promoted by objective 20-session turnover, trading activity and history gates.
policy.discovery: Remaining current HOSE symbols; EOD technical discovery only until liquidity/data gates are met.
policy.promotion: Dynamic from current HOSE membership and market-history liquidity/data gates; independent of forecast freshness.
